question: Where was the FIH Women’s Indoor Hockey World Cup 2015 held?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Leipzig, Germany__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The second of tournament previews looks at the **12 women's teams that will compete in the Arena Leipzig for the championship.**
 
• **Females: Pool A**
 
 
• **World Champions in Excess Together with Germany, Austria, Ukraine, Australia, Canada, and Belgium, they compete in Pool A.**
 
• It's not a big surprise that Germany (FIH Indoor World Ranking: 1) starts the competition as the favourite because of the supportive home audience. But, the club must get over the shock of losing star attacker Lisa Altenburg, who suffered a knee injury at the weekend's German indoor championships.
 
• Luisa Steindor has taken Altenburg's slot, and she will be confident going into the competition after helping Düsseldorf HC win the German indoor championship. Jamilon Mülders, the team's head coach, is enthusiastic about his squad's chances of winning.
